clues: This town is in Bulgaria, in the southwest of the land. It sits at the foot of the Pirin Mountains.
No town in this country has a higher average yearly temperature. That warm record helps make it a place for rest.
Until 1947, this town used a different name in daily life. A new name then replaced the old one for good.
This town has an unusually rich supply of warm springs. People come here to relax and enjoy the warm waters.
It stands a short trip from the Greek border, and the Aegean Sea lies not far away.
